# Answer key: samples/contracts/ferrolino-msa-draft.md

Kept outside `examples/morvento/` so agents reviewing the contract can't read it. A good legal review finds at least the high items.

| # | Clause | Issue | Severity | Morvento position (roles/legal.md) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| K1 | 2.2 | 120 days end of month: over the 60-day B2B limit (D.Lgs. 231/2002) and over our rule | high | 30 days, at most 60 end of month |
| K2 | 6.1 | Unlimited liability, indirect damages and loss of profit included | high | Cap at 12 months of fees, no indirect damages |
| K3 | 5.1 | Assignment of all IP, including Morvento Assist and pre-existing software | high | Our pre-existing IP stays ours; client owns bespoke deliverables once paid |
| K4 | 7 | No DPA (GDPR art. 28); indefinite retention; use of client data to improve the software | high | DPA, EU processing, deletion at end, no use beyond the service (also manifesto: client data) |
| K5 | 3.2 | Termination at will by the client, no payment for work done | high | Never sign |
| K6 | 4.2 | Uncapped penalty of 10% of the setup fee per day | high | Capped at 10% of contract value, grace period |
| K7 | 3.1 | Tacit renewal for 36 months with 6 months' notice | medium | 12 months, renewal by written agreement |
| K8 | — | Unfair terms (2.3, 3, 4.2, 6, 9) without the specific approval of artt. 1341–1342 c.c. | medium | Needs a double-signature clause, or negotiate the terms away |
| K9 | 2.3 | Client may suspend all payments while any complaint is open | medium | Push back |
| K10 | 9 | Court of Piacenza instead of Bologna | low | Push back, acceptable |
| K11 | — | Contract over €10,000: needs legal review before signature (manifesto) | process | — |
